title: running-performance-load-test input
description: ADVISORY — documents the assembled stage input; the engine validates workflow input and stage OUTPUTS only (engine/validation.py). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage perf-load-test.

performance_test_context.description: From workflow input (optional): OPTIONAL runner context for the T9 perf/load gate (live runner mode). Absent in replay. Non-secret.

load_profile.description: Arrival shape: rps/vus/duration — runner-specific but non-secret.

budget.description: Upper bounds (p95/p99/error_rate: observed >= threshold breaches) and the throughput lower bound (observed < threshold breaches).

totals.description: Shape: executing-qa-test-suite schemas/output.json#/properties/totals. executed = passed + failed + skipped; derived from test_results[] when records exist.

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key, injected into every stage payload.

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back.
